resources.string: Create a course in Courses by entering a name and category. Topics and a schedule are optional and can be configured later. Up to 10 unfinished courses can have their own colors.

Type a category or choose a suggestion. A new category is created when you save the course. The trash icon deletes a category independently of the form: canceling the form does not undo this deletion. Courses remain without a category.

Edit list opens unfinished topics as text, one per line. Paste, reorder or remove lines and choose Apply. Cancel keeps the previous list. Completed topics remain outside the editor; matching names block applying and show the conflicting line numbers.

Hold a saved topic to mark it complete. Hold it again to remove the mark. A short tap does nothing; scrolling cancels the gesture. Save pending list edits before using this gesture. Manual topic marks never create calendar sessions.

Choose Configure in an unfinished course to set weekdays and start times. End times and the final date are optional. Equal times mean zero minutes; an earlier end means the next day. Configuring a paused course resumes sessions. Topics are not assigned to dates.

Today shows sessions for today and the next study day. After the end time, or 90 minutes after the start if no end was set, an unanswered session asks whether you studied. Choose Done and select the topics you actually finished, in any order. You may also save Done with no finished topics. Skipped does not change topic progress.

Choose a date in Calendar to view session results. Only today’s session can be changed. Bright stripes mean Done; pale stripes mean Planned or Skipped, with a cross for skipped sessions. Past unanswered sessions become Skipped on the next day. Courses without topics count completed sessions instead of showing a percentage.

A completion offer appears when marking a session that completes the final topic. The course shows All topics completed. New sessions stop until incomplete topics are added. Pause keeps history and the color. Completing marks remaining topics complete, releases the color and prevents editing. Deleting permanently removes the course and its history.

Enable reminders in Settings and allow Android notifications. If Android requests permission for alarms and reminders, allow it for reminders at the exact start time. Reminders are sent only when a scheduled session starts. The question about its result stays inside the app. Declining permission does not block the tracker.
